title: pct table: tcW pct shares beat a placeholder or off-total grid; a non-uniform grid summing to the pct width is read as Word's layout
source: probe build.py, Letter 9360-twip column, tblW pct 5000, tcW pct 750/2000/1500/750, Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf rule centres

cases.note: uniform placeholder grid 2340 x 4: Word draws the tcW pct shares (rules 1445/2846/6586/9394/10795)
non-uniform grid summing to 6000, not the pct width: tcW shares again
tcW dxa equal to a grid summing to the column: that grid (rules 1445/3350/6821/9355/10795)
invented non-uniform grid summing to the column with disagreeing tcW pct: Word draws the tcW shares; gen keeps the grid as a Word-saved layout (same trade-off as the dxa rule, see the truth section)
